working_features: Runs in a REPL loop accepting commands
Generates random password with configurable length (default 16)
Set length with 'length' command
Toggle character sets (uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols) on/off
Generates passwords using only enabled character sets
Displays strength rating (weak, medium, strong, very strong) with bits
Generate multiple passwords with 'generate N'
Shows current configuration with 'config'
Refuses generation if all character sets disabled with error message
Toggle ambiguous character exclusion (0/O, 1/l/I)
Supports 'quit' or 'exit' to stop
Supports passphrase generation with configurable words and separator
